commit_message:
decomp: recover 12 allocation/layout matches (A2DE 4.329497%)

Recover Object258's grouped 0x4A0 member layout and original allocation
sizes for Object76, Object249, Object341, Object342, Object343, Object344,
Object348, Object350, Object354, Object367 and Object368.

Add 720 matching code bytes and 12 matching functions over 296e67f.
Totals: 124,536 / 2,876,454 code bytes and 1,465 / 15,667 functions.
Matching data remains 4,276 / 851,344 and no previous match is lost.

Object258::create is an exact instruction-and-relocation match. The other
11 factories reproduce the complete ARM instruction stream and size; their
remaining objdiff fuzziness is equivalent provisional constructor/vtable
relocation labels documented in the layout report.

No ROM or extracted original game binaries are published.
